issue: The goat and polygon items are scored with parameters estimated from a handful of responses, though children have since answered them thousands of times.
action: Recalibrate these items on the current release.

issue: Many items have parameters from fewer than 100 responses. Set-3 items appear only on the fixed form.
action: Recalibrate on the current release; check that set-3 items have enough fixed-form responses.

issue: Most item-language combinations have parameters from fewer than 100 responses.
action: Recalibrate on the current release.

issue: The English bank was calibrated on few responses per item, and the deployed task version has changed since calibration.
action: Recalibrate the English bank with the newer English data (Ontario, Sheffield) on the current task version.

issue: trog_embedding_cat_cow_chase_black (German), trog_embedding_boy_dog_chase_big (Spanish) and trog_conjcoord_say_sunny_however_rain (German, Spanish) are answered below chance.
action: Exclude these item-language combinations from calibration and scoring until the item-bank check is done.

issue: Fraction items are answered below chance, mostly in Spanish.
action: Exclude them from calibration and scoring until the item-bank check is done.

issue: Words answered below chance: claw, divan, dredging, squash (German); aesthete, divan, ecstatic, skimmer, squash (Spanish).
action: Exclude them from that language's calibration until the item-bank check is done.

issue: matrix_set1_md_mat59, mat12 and mat66 are answered below chance in two or three languages; mat26, mat27, mat35 and mat42 in one.
action: Exclude them until their answer keys are checked.

issue: Reference items (stories 5, 11, 17) and reality-check items (story 4) are answered below chance; the study recommends changes to which items are excluded.
action: Apply the Stories study's item exclusions and key fixes at the next calibration.

issue: The scale's low end is anchored mostly by school-age children; under-6 data now exist from Boston, Sparklab, LangCog and Leuphana.
action: Include the under-6 datasets in calibration so the bottom of each scale is estimated from young children.

issue: A few length-8 trials are uncalibrated or calibrated on almost no data.
action: Exclude length-8 trials, or calibrate them once there are enough.

issue: New scoring models are pending. Scores in Sheffield and Caquetá/Boyacá pile up on one value.
action: Fit the new models after the match-block recoding fix (see Scoring pipeline).

issue: The items listed under Recalibration are answered below chance in specific languages.
action: Check the German and Spanish sentences, pictures and answer keys.

issue: Fraction items answered below chance.
action: Check the answer keys and the Spanish and German wording.

issue: Words answered below chance in German or Spanish.
action: Check the translations and whether the pictures show the intended meaning.

issue: Items answered below chance across languages, which points to the key rather than translation.
action: Check the answer keys of the listed items.

issue: Reference and reality-check items answered below chance.
action: Check the keys and wording, following the Stories study's item audit.

issue: sre_uzh_4 (German) and four AI-generated Spanish sentences are answered below chance.
action: Check each sentence's true/false key.

issue: Spanish items answered below chance; in lexical decision this can be intended (rare real words, word-like pseudowords).
action: Review the listed items; keep those that are hard by design.

issue: Accuracy on the polygon items rises with rotation angle, the reverse of the other stimuli.
action: Check the polygon answer keys and how rotations are rendered.

issue: Few items are harder than the strongest children's scores; there are few 3-D items.
action: Add harder items, e.g. more 3-D shapes at more angles.

issue: Children under 4 are at the bottom of the scale; the bank has few items for them.
action: Add easier items for the youngest children.

issue: Practice before the second block uses up its timer.
action: Apply the timing changes from the block-timing replay (e.g. drop the something-same practice for children 5 and older).

issue: Scores pile up near the top of the range in some datasets.
action: Follow the v2 redesign study's recommendations.

issue: Many children do a different task version in their second wave than in their first (in some datasets most of them), which muddies retest.
action: Keep a child's task version fixed across waves where possible, and record version changes in the release notes.

issue: Since the August 2026 prompt change, `recode_sds()` drops every match-block response, so scores rest on the first two blocks only. Every Sheffield run is after the change, which likely explains its ceiling.
action: Merge the fix and rescore runs since August.

issue: Daily releases since v3.19 intermittently lack IRT scores for some datasets; v5.0 is the last complete one, so the site is pinned to it.
action: Find why scoring drops datasets, then move the pinned release forward.

issue: No German run has a score, although a German item bank is calibrated.
action: Score the German runs.

issue: Many English runs on task version 5.1 have no score.
action: Find why and score them.

issue: A low share of Ghana's runs is scored, and some Bogotá runs have no age.
action: Check the Ghana scoring and fill in the missing ages.

issue: Stories scores changed between releases without a registry note.
action: Find out what changed and record it in the release notes.

issue: The adaptive flag is missing on some early runs; this site fills it in as fixed form.
action: Fill it in upstream.

issue: Retest is defined here as a child's first two waves; the datapage uses its own definition.
action: Agree one definition with Mika and use it on both sites.

issue: No child does both board sizes in one run, so linking the 2×2 and 3×3 boards rests on the calibration.
action: Decide whether a short mixed-board form is worth deploying to test the linking.

issue: These tasks are calibrated separately in each language, so levels can't be compared across languages.
action: Decide whether cross-language comparison is needed and, if so, design anchor items.

issue: Runs that end well before the time window, common in Argentina, lower the score's validity; in Ghana accuracy is near chance.
action: Decide whether to flag or exclude short runs, and what to do about Ghana.
